statement: For locally small complete infinity coefficients, full faithfulness/equivalence of the specified restriction is detected by its homotopy-category restriction.
manuscript_rows_or_pages_settled: I ms.99-100; Part B enhancement question
notes: Cotensors by all small spaces supply the required mapping-space tests.

statement: For complete and cocomplete enhanced coefficients, cohomological, homological, and 1-complete equivalences coincide and are precisely maps with coefficient-acyclic homotopy fibers.
notes: Uses groupoid Kan formulas; does not silently assert the same for arbitrary derivators.

statement: Constant coefficient equivalences are exactly the maps whose tensor with every coefficient object is an equivalence.
notes: Includes empty and infinitely disconnected indexing spaces.

statement: For r-types, W=W_r; the middle class is pi0 bijective, pi_i iso through r, and pi_(r+1) onto; Wlc=W_(r+1).
notes: Sets and groupoids are r=0 and r=1. CATHOT reflector statement cited without reproof.

statement: Finite truncation stages have both strict inclusions and W1 fails two-out-of-three; for spaces all classes equal W_infinity.
For a connected pointed space, local systems of k-modules are modules over chains on its based loop space; restriction is along the specified loop-algebra map.
notes: No finite type, nilpotence, or simply connected restriction.

statement: For any nonzero associative unital ring: constants test k-homology, middle classes test k-acyclic homotopy fibers, and Wlc tests pi0/pi1 plus universal-cover k-homology.
notes: Loop-algebra proof; integral bar/cobar followed by scalar extension; zero ring handled separately.

statement: W1 is the homological-epimorphism condition B tensor_A B -> B; for every prederivator W and W1 coincide on maps to the point.
notes: Refutes the prompt assertion that BA -> * for acyclic A is not 1-complete; reversing the map gives the intended separation.

statement: Ring homology tests are detected by rational homology when characteristic zero and mod-p homology for primes not inverted in k; Wlc_k=W_infinity iff no prime is invertible.
notes: Includes all nonzero associative unital rings; integral Whitehead proof supplied.

statement: For spectra: constants are integral homology equivalences, middle classes have integral-acyclic fibers, and Wlc=W_infinity.
notes: Uses bounded-below stable Hurewicz detection only where it applies.

statement: For E-local spectra: constants are E-homology equivalences, middle classes have E-acyclic fibers, and Wlc is component bijection plus E-homology equivalence of based loops.
notes: Nonzero E; zero E separately. For Morava K(n), Wlc strictly exceeds weak equivalences. No unsupported replacement of loop tests by cover tests.

statement: The Wlc < W1 < W inclusions are strict for every nonzero ring, spectra, and nonzero E-local spectra; rational and mod-p Wlc also strictly exceed W_infinity.
notes: Explicit acyclic presentation CW complex, finite A5 quotient, code/output, and corrected acyclic-group examples.

statement: Wlc_D(Q) is the established pi1-rational/fiberwise-rational equivalence class, with GHT finite-type algebraic models where applicable.
notes: Finite-type condition belongs to GHT models, not to the equivalence-class calculation.

statement: Rational Wlc implies Toën schematization equivalence, strictly; the discrete pi1 test is stronger than proalgebraic pi1 plus finite-dimensional cohomology.
notes: Uncountable acyclic simple group supplies strictness; reverses a typo after Toën Definition3.1.1.

statement: The full coefficient table and empty/disconnected/idempotent edge cases follow from the preceding exact calculations.
notes: All requested coefficient cases included with the exact middle class.
